syllabus.clause: vectorized execution processes batches instead of rows to cut interpreter overhead (MonetDB/X100, CIDR 2005), using selection vectors. The alternative is data-centric code generation (HyPer, VLDB 2011); Kersten et al. (VLDB 2018) compare the two. Polars and DataFusion are vectorized Arrow engines.
